overview.summary: agent-board itself: the shared kanban the arc and chaim backlogs run on. This board dogfoods the tool — capability and customer-experience ideas for the tool land here as ideas, framed around its two customers: the human deciding what to build, and the agent operating the board. No milestones yet; the backlog is ideas-first until a direction is ratified.
